Checks 33.83, 33.82, 33.69 and 33.66 all pass when run in that order, so the failure in the full run is fixed. I only reran those four in one tab, not the whole block. The full-run result will show on the next corpus pass.

**Cause:** checks 33.83 (`cw-pixhub`) and 33.82 (`cw-pixlamps`) deliberately make `pixWrap` throw. That adds one to `PIX.errs`, a counter nothing resets, and the later reads in 33.69 and 33.66 saw it as one pixel fault. A player can't reach this state, so there is no game change.

**Fix:** both checks now put `PIX.errs` back to its starting value when they finish. The fixture fix is committed as `7147a374e`. 33.69 and 33.66 are untouched, so a fault during their own drawing still fails them. Nothing shipped through the queue; it is a fixture-only change.

I wrote no notes file and no `DESIGN.md` section. The bisect lists and outputs (`111-list-*.txt`, `111-out-*.txt`) are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/`.

TASK DONE
